basic_profile.bio: Gill is a 28-year-old game designer from Austin, Texas, who's been on Reddit for a year and a half. They have a passion for Pokémon and enjoy trading rare and unique Pokémon with other fans. Gill spends their free time sketching fantasy weapons, a hobby that aligns with their professional work. They also enjoy medieval-themed humor and often visit related subreddits. Generally online during the late evenings, Gill is single and enjoys the flexibility that comes with their job to explore various hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gill has a strong background in game design, having studied interactive media and game development in college. They have self-taught skills in digital art, which they use in their profession to design game elements. Their interest in Pokémon began in childhood, and they have since acquired extensive knowledge in breeding mechanics and trading strategies.
